message.content: **Summary:** I researched Apple's latest results using primary sources — Apple's Q4 FY2024 newsroom release and the FY2024 Form 10-K on SEC EDGAR — and cross-checked the quote (AAPL at $222.70, bid/ask $222.68/$222.72). Apple's fiscal 2024 (ended Sept 28, 2024) showed total net sales of $391,035 million (up from $383,285 million in FY2023), operating income of $123,216 million, net income of $93,736 million, and diluted EPS of $6.08 — the latter depressed by a one-time $10.2 billion income tax charge in Q4, with quarterly revenue of $94.9 billion up 6% year over year. I noted that one search result misstated these figures in millions rather than billions, and I relied on the Apple release and 10-K instead. News flow was neutral-to-constructive: shares were roughly flat around $222 as analysts weighed iPhone 16 demand and the gradual Apple Intelligence rollout, which is a reasonable setup for a modest position rather than an aggressive one. I therefore bought 44 shares of AAPL at a limit of $222.80 (just above the ask, so it filled immediately at $222.80) for about $9,803 — within the $10,000 per-order cap and well under the $20,000 daily total, with no funds moved out of the account.
